items.headline: $PENDLE Drops 34.8% APY on Tokenized Yield Product
items.summary: $PENDLE is turning heads with a new tokenized product advertising a hefty 34.8% APY, as yield-hungry DeFi users pile back into Pendle's markets.

items.headline: $SPK Expands $USDS Activity With New $1B Pool
items.summary: Spark Finance is scaling its $USDS stablecoin ecosystem with a fresh $1B pool, marking one of the biggest DeFi liquidity expansions this week. $SPK holders are watching closely.

items.headline: $AAVE Adds Stablecoin Deposits to Its Mobile App

items.headline: $JUP Exec Lays Out DeFi's Path to Mainstream Users

items.headline: $EIGEN Restaking Hype Fades as Profits Dry Up
items.summary: The restaking gold rush is cooling fast — top protocols like $EIGEN are barely turning a profit as yields compress and the hype cycle ends.
